lead: Rahul Dev Burman was an Indian composer, born on 27 June 1939 in Kolkata.
He died on 4 January 1994 in Mumbai at the age of 54.
He has 60 credited works on public record and has been recognised with Filmfare Award for Best Music Director and Filmfare Award for Best Music Director.
This profile collects the Rahul facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Rahul Dev Burman — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Rahul Dev Burman was born on 27 June 1939 in Kolkata, and holds citizenship of India, British Raj and Dominion of India.
Public records name his father, Sachin Dev Burman and his mother, Meera Dev Burman.
He received his education at Ballygunge Government High School.
He is recorded as speaking Bangla, Hindi and English.

sections.heading: Rahul Dev Burman — Career and Professional Work
paras: Rahul Dev Burman works primarily as a film score composer, recording artist, director, actor and musician.
